source_note: 关于序列极限的公开问题
callout_id: 关于序列极限的公开问题#7
statement_en: Let $a_1>0$, and suppose the sequence satisfies the difference equation $$\Delta a_n= \frac{f(n)}{S_n}$$ where $f(n)>0$ and $f(n)\sim \alpha n^{2\beta}$. Then $$\lim_{n\to \infty} \frac{a_n}{n^{\beta}} =\sqrt{\frac{\alpha(\beta+1)}{\beta}}.$$
key_techniques: asymptotic analysis of nonlinear difference equations
callout_body: $a_1>0$，并且满足差分方程$$\Delta a_n= \frac{f(n)}{S_n}$$其中$f(n)>0$并且满足$f(n)\sim \alpha n^{2\beta}$那么$$\lim_{n\to \infty} \frac{a_n}{n^{\beta}} =\sqrt{\frac{\alpha(\beta+1)}{\beta}}$$
